LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN KENYA ● RELIEF ● DRAINAGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are physical features useful in a country?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main physical features in Kenya
2. show main physical features in Kenya on a map
3. value physical features found in Kenya

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN KENYA ● RELIEF ● DRAINAGE
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN KENYA ● RELIEF ● DRAINAGE
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Identify main physical features in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to identify main physical features in Kenya. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify main physical features in Kenya.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify main physical features in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Show main physical features in Kenya on a map

What this means
In this part you learn to show main physical features in Kenya on a map. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: show main physical features in Kenya on a map.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can show main physical features in Kenya on a map. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Value physical features found in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to value physical features found in Kenya. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value physical features found in Kenya.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Participate: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value physical features found in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: identify main physical features in Kenya)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage. (skill: show main physical features in Kenya on a map)

Example 3: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take. (skill: value physical features found in Kenya)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify main physical features in Kenya.
3. Practise this skill: show main physical features in Kenya on a map.
4. Practise this skill: value physical features found in Kenya.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are physical features useful in a country?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify main physical features in Kenya.
5. Be able to: show main physical features in Kenya on a map.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
